title: Past simple di be: was / were
rule: Be al passato ha due forme: was per I, he, she, it e were per you, we, they. Negativo con not (wasn't, weren't), domanda invertendo (Was it…? Were you…?), risposte brevi con was / wasn't, were / weren't. Un solo passato per l'italiano ero, sono stato, fui. There was / there were = c'era / c'erano. Was born = sono nato.

blocks.caption: be · past simple: affermativo, negativo, domanda

head: Inglese
Italiano
rows: I was at the bank. She was late. It was cold.
Ero in banca. Era in ritardo. Faceva freddo.
You were right. We were tired. They were nice.
Avevi ragione. Eravamo stanchi. Erano gentili.
I wasn't there. They weren't open.
Non ero lì. Non erano aperti.
Was it hard? — No, it wasn't. Were you there? — Yes, I was.
È stato difficile? — No. Eri lì? — Sì.
Where were you? How was your day? Who was it?
Dov'eri? Com'è andata la giornata? Chi era?
There was a line. There were two advisors. There wasn't any coffee.
C'era una fila. C'erano due consulenti. Non c'era caffè.
I was born in 1999. Where were you born?
Sono nato/a nel 1999. Dove sei nato/a?

items.t: Yesterday it was sunny. Last winter it was minus twenty.
items.n: Ieri c'era il sole. L'inverno scorso c'erano meno venti.

items.t: I was here in 2019. It was my first trip.
items.n: Ero qui nel 2019. Era il mio primo viaggio.

items.t: The fees weren't small, but the advisor was patient.
items.n: Le commissioni non erano piccole, ma il consulente era paziente.

items.t: Were you at the party? — No, I was at work.
items.n: Eri alla festa? — No, ero al lavoro.

blocks.title: Un passato, non tre
blocks.text: L'italiano sceglie fra [[era]], [[è stato]] e [[fu]]. L'inglese dice [[was]] e basta. La scelta fra imperfetto e passato prossimo, che in italiano è grammatica, in inglese è contesto. L'unico caso in cui l'inglese separa è l'azione in corso: [[I was waiting]] (past continuous, unità 11).

items.wrong: I were, you was, we was
items.right: I was, you were, we were
items.why: Was: I, he, she, it. Were: you, we, they.

items.wrong: Did it was cold? Did you were there?
items.right: Was it cold? Were you there?

items.wrong: I am born in Italy. I borned in Italy.
items.why: Was / were born, sempre al passato.
There was / there were: c'era / c'erano.
La contrazione è la norma nel parlato.

items.q: Where ___ you born? — I ___ born in Roccamarina. There ___ (not) a hospital, so I ___ born in Lecce.
items.n: Dove sei nata? — Sono nata a Roccamarina. Non c'era un ospedale, quindi sono nata a Lecce.

items.q: Was the bank open? — No, it wasn't. It was Sunday.
